name.zh: 白川乡与五箇山合掌造聚落
name.en: Historic Villages of Shirakawa-go and Gokayama

description.zh: 白川乡和五箇山是保存完整的「合掌造」茅草屋顶村落，独特的60度斜面大屋顶形如双手合十祈祷，以承载冬季重雪。这两处山间聚落于1995年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: Shirakawa-go and Gokayama are remarkably preserved villages of gassho-zukuri farmhouses, whose steeply pitched thatched roofs — angled like hands pressed in prayer — are engineered to shed heavy mountain snowfalls. UNESCO-listed in 1995.

location.zh: 岐阜县大野郡白川村及富山县南砺市
location.en: Shirakawa Village, Gifu Prefecture & Nanto, Toyama Prefecture

zh: 合掌造茅草屋顶农家，部分已有300年历史
冬季积雪下的村落景色堪称绝美
荻町城址展望台可俯瞰整个白川乡全景
en: Gassho-zukuri farmhouses, some over 300 years old
Snow-covered village in winter is one of Japan's most magical scenes
Ogimachi Castle Ruins viewpoint offers a sweeping panorama of the village

admission.zh: 部分古民家内部参观收费300—800日元

tips.zh: 冬季点灯节（1—2月）极为抢手，需提前数月报名参加抽签。名古屋或高山出发的日归巴士班次较多。
tips.en: The winter illumination festival (January–February) is hugely popular — apply months ahead by lottery. Day-trip buses from Nagoya or Takayama are frequent.
